modes.name: Bearer Token (Session API Key)
modes.description: Generated per WhatsApp session after connection. Used in Authorization: Bearer <key> header. Scoped to one session.
modes.usage: Session-specific operations (send messages, manage contacts for that session only).

modes.name: Personal Access Token (PAT)
modes.description: Generated from account settings. Used in Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Account-wide scope.
modes.usage: Session management across all sessions (create, list, delete sessions).

trial.description: 1 message every 1 minute during free trial.

accountProtection.description: When account protection is enabled, 1 message per 5 seconds.

paid.description: Higher limits on paid plans. Limits vary by endpoint and plan tier.

appSafetyPolicy.description: Application-level safety policy (PRD §24): ≥5 seconds between outbound sends per session. Independent of Wasender's own rate limits.

endpoints.name: Get All WhatsApp Sessions
endpoints.description: List all sessions for the authenticated account.

endpoints.name: Update WhatsApp Session
endpoints.description: Update session settings; syncs webhook config if connected.

endpoints.name: Delete WhatsApp Session
endpoints.description: Delete a session; disconnects first if connected.

endpoints.name: Get WhatsApp Session Status
endpoints.description: Current status including QR and Passkey linking states.

endpoints.name: Connect WhatsApp Session
endpoints.description: Initiate connection via QR (default) or Passkey.

endpoints.name: Get Message Logs
endpoints.description: Paginated message log for a session.

endpoints.name: Get Passkey Token
endpoints.description: Temporary Passkey token for Device Link Helper.

endpoints.name: Get WhatsApp Session QR Code
endpoints.description: QR code for connecting the session.

endpoints.name: Get Pending Passkey Request
endpoints.description: WebAuthn publicKey options for Passkey linking. Advanced.

endpoints.name: Get Session User Info
endpoints.description: WhatsApp user info for the session.

endpoints.name: Check if a contact is on WhatsApp
endpoints.description: Verify if a phone/JID/username is registered.

endpoints.name: Send Presence Update
endpoints.description: Send typing/recording presence to a JID.

endpoints.name: Get All Contacts
endpoints.description: List synced contacts for the session.

endpoints.name: Create or Update Contact
endpoints.description: Upsert a contact in the session address book.

endpoints.name: Get LID from Phone Number
endpoints.description: Get Link ID (LID) from phone number.

endpoints.name: Get Phone Number from LID
endpoints.description: Get phone number from Link ID.

to.description: Recipient phone (E.164), WhatsApp JID, username handle, Group JID, or Channel JID.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image.

audioUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the audio file.

videoUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the video.

documentUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the document.

quoted.description: Message key object of the message to quote/reply to.

mediaUrl.description: Image, video, or audio URL (viewed once).

mentions.description: Array of participant JIDs to mention.

key.description: Exact message key object from the webhook payload (triggers blue ticks).

actions.name: Edit a Message

text.description: New text content (only possible for a short period after sending).

actions.note: Time-limited: only possible shortly after the message was sent.

actions.name: Delete a Message
actions.note: Time-limited: only possible shortly after the message was sent.

message.description: ID of the failed message from the logs.

actions.name: Upload Media File

file.description: Raw binary or Base64-encoded file upload.

actions.note: Returns a URL usable in send-message media parameters. Use as intermediate step before sending media.

actions.name: Decrypt Media File

mediaKey.description: Encryption key from the incoming message webhook.

url.description: Encrypted media URL from the incoming message webhook.

actions.note: Returns a publicUrl valid for 1 hour. Use to download received media files from incoming webhook messages.

endpoints.name: Create a New Group
endpoints.description: Create a WhatsApp group with name and participants.

endpoints.name: Get All Groups
endpoints.description: List groups the session is a member of.

endpoints.name: Update Group Settings
endpoints.description: Subject, description, announce mode, restrict mode (admin).

endpoints.name: Accept Group Invite
endpoints.description: Join a group via invite code.

webhookEvents.name: Message Received
webhookEvents.description: Incoming messages (private + group). Fires for every new message received.

webhookEvents.name: Message Upsert
webhookEvents.description: ALL messages (both incoming and outgoing) in the session. Broader than messages.received.

webhookEvents.name: Personal Message Received
webhookEvents.description: New message in a direct one-to-one chat. Distinct from groups/newsletters.

webhookEvents.name: Group Message Received
webhookEvents.description: New message in a group. Includes group JID and sender participant JID.

webhookEvents.name: Newsletter Message Received
webhookEvents.description: New message published in a newsletter/channel the session subscribes to.

webhookEvents.name: Message Sent
webhookEvents.description: Outbound message successfully sent. Can trigger post-send followup workflows.

webhookEvents.name: Message Reaction
webhookEvents.description: Someone reacted to a message with an emoji.

webhookEvents.name: Poll Results
webhookEvents.description: A poll vote was cast by a user.

webhookEvents.name: Contact Upsert
webhookEvents.description: New contact added or existing contact updated in the session's contact list.

webhookEvents.name: Contact Update
webhookEvents.description: Contact profile picture or status changed.

webhookEvents.name: Group Participants Update
webhookEvents.description: Participants added, removed, promoted, or demoted in a group. Includes action field.

webhookEvents.name: Group Upsert
webhookEvents.description: Session joined a new group, or existing group metadata (subject/description) updated.

webhookEvents.name: Group Update
webhookEvents.description: Group settings changed (e.g., announce mode, restrict mode) by an admin.

webhookEvents.name: Session Status
webhookEvents.description: Session connection state changed (connecting, connected, disconnected, need_scan, etc.).

webhookEvents.name: Call Received
webhookEvents.description: Incoming voice or video call. Includes call ID, caller JID, and video flag.

webhookEvents.name: Message Status Update
webhookEvents.reason: Raw status-update events (delivered, read, played). Too noisy and low-signal as a workflow trigger.

webhookEvents.name: Message Deleted
webhookEvents.reason: Deletion event — the message is already gone, so there is nothing actionable to trigger on.

webhookEvents.name: Chat Delete
webhookEvents.reason: Low-level chat deletion event, not user-initiated conversation content.

webhookEvents.name: Chat Update
webhookEvents.reason: Unread count, mute status — too granular for workflow triggering.

webhookEvents.name: Message Receipt Update
webhookEvents.reason: Internal receipt-level status changes (group receipt tracking). Too noisy.

webhookEvents.name: Passkey Updated
webhookEvents.reason: Passkey auth flow — not message-driven or workflow-relevant.

webhookEvents.name: QR Code Updated
webhookEvents.reason: QR code linking flow — authentication-side event, not conversation-driven.

webhookSetup.headerAuth: X-Authorization header with your API key

events.note: Enable specific event types via the Wasender dashboard or session update API.

image.description: JPEG, PNG via publicly accessible URL.

audio.description: Audio file via publicly accessible URL.

video.description: Video file via publicly accessible URL.

document.description: Any document via publicly accessible URL; optional fileName.

location.description: Location object: { latitude, longitude, name?, address? }.

poll.description: Poll: { question, options[], multiSelect? }. Options: min 2, max 12.

quoted.description: Quoted/reply message: message key object of the original message.

viewOnce.description: View-once image/video/audio. Requires viewOnce: true + media URL.

mentions.description: Group message with @mentions: array of participant JIDs.

mediaTypes.decryptDescription: Decrypt media from incoming webhook messages. Returns publicUrl valid for 1 hour.
mediaTypes.note: Media from webhooks is encrypted. Use decrypt-media endpoint + mediaKey + url from the webhook payload.
